diagnosis.basis: Observed null response plus independent comparison of the source visit URLs.
diagnosis.cause: The previous visit URL changed only the fragment when opening another lesson on the same page. That can be a same-document navigation with no HTTP response. retainedWork called visit after the first direct-entry journey and response.status() dereferenced null.
diagnosis.correction: A monotonic visitSequence is appended to the query for each visit. This changes the document URL even when the requested lesson repeats. The source commit query, lesson fragment and strict response.status() === 200 assertion are retained.
diagnosis.notChanged: No null-response allowance, in-review preview, count relaxation, TLS bypass, hash relaxation, fixture state injection or application/runtime/content change.
